exclusive_groups.scope: Current primary explanation or explicit inability to attribute; mixed causation is reported separately.

likelihood_scale.interpretation: The evidence is similarly expected under the competing hypotheses.
likelihood_scale.assignment_rule: Use when the evidence fits several explanations and has little diagnostic value.

likelihood_scale.interpretation: The evidence modestly favours one hypothesis.
likelihood_scale.assignment_rule: Require a stated alternative explanation and dependency review.
Require inspectable evidence, source authority and an explicit likelihood rationale.

likelihood_scale.interpretation: The evidence would be substantially more expected under one hypothesis.
likelihood_scale.assignment_rule: Require independent review and sensitivity testing.

likelihood_scale.interpretation: Competing explanations have difficulty accounting for the evidence.

dependency_policy.correlation_method: Count one full-weight evidence contribution per independence group; document and discount derivative contributions.

tests.variable: Each hypothesis prior within its declared minimum and maximum.
tests.low_assumption: Use all declared lower bounds where coherent.
tests.high_assumption: Use all declared upper bounds where coherent.
tests.reported_output: Range of posterior ordering and any change in leading hypothesis.
Whether the conclusion depends on one evidence origin.

tests.variable: Dependence between repeated or related reports.
tests.low_assumption: Treat derivative reports as zero additional weight.
tests.high_assumption: Apply the maximum documented partial contribution.
tests.reported_output: Change in probability ranges caused by source dependence.

tests.variable: Order of organic mobilisation and state response.
tests.low_assumption: Organic mobilisation clearly precedes state action.
tests.reported_output: Effect on organic, deliberate and mixed-cause hypotheses.

scoring_contract.resolution_standard: Score only against an independently documented outcome definition established before resolution review.
scoring_contract.unresolved_outcome_policy: Retain as unresolved and exclude from accuracy scoring while preserving the forecast and revision history.
scoring_contract.reporting_cadence: Publish calibration and discrimination summaries after at least 20 resolved forecasts and thereafter at fixed review intervals.

forecast_ledger.reason: Added sensitivity, scoring and explicit safety controls without changing probabilities.

update_triggers.description: An authenticated operational instruction or communication becomes available.
update_triggers.expected_effect: May materially change deliberate domestic or foreign-command hypotheses.
update_triggers.required_action: Create a new immutable revision, reassess source dependence and rerun sensitivity tests.

update_triggers.description: Independent evidence establishes the origin and timing of mobilisation.
update_triggers.expected_effect: May distinguish organic, pre-planned and mixed-cause sequences.
update_triggers.required_action: Update the evidence ledger and create a new forecast revision only if the sufficiency gate passes.

update_triggers.description: A judicial, parliamentary, official or archival investigation publishes outcome evidence.
update_triggers.expected_effect: May permit resolution scoring or require the case to remain disputed.
update_triggers.required_action: Apply the predeclared resolution standard and preserve unresolved status where evidence remains inadequate.
